name: Neurothera Labs Inc.
summary: Neurothera Labs Inc. engages in the development of a portfolio of drugs based on cannabinoid molecules. The company develops programs based on tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and/or non-psychoactive cannabidiol for the treatment of Tourette syndrome, Alzheimer's disease and agitation, autism spectrum disorder, and status epilepticus. It also focuses on e-commerce operations, which sells hemp-based products. Neurothera Labs Inc. was formerly known as Miza III Ventures Inc. The company is based in Newark, Delaware. Neurothera Labs Inc. is a subsidiary of SciSparc Ltd.
